correctness.rationale: The graph definition reduces each row to a union of coordinate equalities. Unit-scaling symmetry diagonalizes the unit-side Gram matrix in the orthogonal character basis. Character cancellation yields explicit support-dependent row Fourier sums; summing over all nonempty proper zero-divisor supports produces the displayed eigenvalue formulas, including the empty and full support boundaries. Every proper-support eigenvalue is positive by an explicit summand, so rank M−F and bipartite eigenvalue pairing prove the entire characteristic polynomial. Direct enumeration checks the complete Gram eigenspectrum and rank on 188 field-size tuples; finite checks are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: The explicit all-parameter characteristic polynomial directly resolves the first named spectral problem of the graph-defining 2025 work for every finite reduced nonfield. It includes unequal field orders, exact eigenvalue multiplicities, the full incidence rank and graph nullity. The support-wise harmonic decomposition explains the graph’s algebraic source of spectral degeneracy and provides a reusable method for other additive ring incidence operators. It is not an arbitrary isolated computation or a restatement of the graph definition.
